content: Hello! how can I help today?
I paid for graduate courses—can I get a tax break?

Yes, you may qualify for the **Lifetime Learning Credit (LLC)**:
- Worth up to $2,000 per return
- 20% of up to $10,000 in eligible tuition and fees
- No limit on number of years claimed

Use **Form 8863** to claim it.
Can I use this and the American Opportunity Credit?
Not in the same year for the same student. AOC is for undergraduates (max 4 years), while LLC is for any level. You can alternate credits in different years or for different students.
Yes, as long as they are from an **eligible institution**. The IRS requires the school be eligible to participate in federal student aid programs. Accredited online programs typically qualify.
Keep **Form 1098-T**, course enrollment documents, and payment receipts. If the 1098-T doesn’t reflect your actual out-of-pocket costs, you can still claim based on eligible amounts you paid.
